prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objective “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your case, how much experience you want, whether you need a trial attorney, your budget, and how comfortable you are with the lawyer. I can help you find strong options, but first here are practical ways to pick the best lawyer for you and the things to check.

What to look for
- Focus/experience: A lawyer who handles car-accident/personal-injury cases regularly (not mostly real estate or family law).  
- Trial experience: Many cases settle, but trial experience matters if the insurer won’t pay fairly.  
- Local knowledge: Experience with Phoenix/Maricopa County courts, judges, and local insurance adjusters.  
- Track record: Past settlements/verdicts in similar cases (amounts and circumstances).  
- Peer/third-party ratings: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell (AV rating), Avvo, or state bar discipline history.  
- Client reviews: Google, Yelp, and real client testimonials.  
- Clear fee arrangement: Contingency fee percentage, how expenses are handled, what happens if you lose.  
- Communication: How quickly they respond, who you’ll speak with (attorney vs. paralegal), and how often you’ll get updates.  
- Personal fit: Trust and comfort level — you’ll be sharing medical and financial info.

Resources to find and compare lawyers
- Arizona State Bar lawyer search (to confirm license and discipline record)  
- SuperLawyers.com (regional “Top Lists”)  
- Martindale-Hubbell (peer-review ratings)  
- Avvo and Google/Yelp reviews  
- Better Business Bureau

Important questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases like mine (injury type, fault issues, high medical bills)?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will it be you or a team member?  
- What is your contingency fee and how are costs handled?  
- What results have you achieved in cases like mine?  
- What is a realistic range for my case, and what would you recommend as a settlement strategy?  
- How often will you update me and by what method?

Immediate steps you should take now (if you haven’t already)
- Seek and follow medical care. Document everything.  
- Preserve photos, police report, witness info, repair estimates, and medical bills/records.  
- Don’t sign releases or give recorded statements to insurers without talking to a lawyer.  
- Avoid posting details or photos of the accident/injuries on social media.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a curated list of well-rated Phoenix personal injury attorneys who handle car accidents (with contact info and reasons they might fit your case), or  
- Narrow recommendations based on your case details (injuries, fault dispute, amount at stake, whether you want trial-ready counsel).

Tell me which you prefer and share any key details about your case (injuries, date of accident, fault/insurance situation, whether you already spoke to insurers). I’ll prepare a short, targeted shortlist.
